Package dev.oumaimaa.kawaiiapi.items

Class ItemUtils

java.lang.Object
dev.oumaimaa.kawaiiapi.items.ItemUtils
public final class ItemUtils extends Object
Modern utility class for creating and manipulating Minecraft items using Paper's Adventure API. Provides builder-style methods for creating items with custom properties without deprecated methods.
Version:
1.0
Author:
KawaiiDevelopment

    • makeItem

      @NotNull public static @NotNull org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack makeItem(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.Material material, @NotNull @NotNull String displayName, @NotNull @NotNull String... lore)
      Creates an ItemStack with display name and lore using modern Component API. Supports legacy color codes (&) and hex colors (invalid input: '&#'RRGGBB).
      Parameters:
      material - The material type for the item
      displayName - The display name (supports color codes)
      lore - The lore lines (supports color codes)
      Returns:
      The constructed ItemStack

    • makeItem

      @NotNull public static @NotNull org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack makeItem(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.Material material, int amount, @NotNull @NotNull String displayName, @NotNull @NotNull String... lore)
      Creates an ItemStack with a specific amount.
      Parameters:
      material - The material type for the item
      amount - The stack size (1-64, clamped automatically)
      displayName - The display name (supports color codes)
      lore - The lore lines (supports color codes)
      Returns:
      The constructed ItemStack
